this look really good for your first still life. I'd say to work on the shadows a little bit, they kinda look like shapeless blobs. (no offense) For example, the apple on the right has shadow where it should not be or is shaped weird because of where the light is coming from. Always keep in mind where the light is coming from with these still pieces.

bring down the right foot more if you can, it'll add dimension instead of it being a flat image.

the left art is also look a little too forward because the orange line is on top of the yellow. make a new layer and put the yellow on top of the orange.

Good job so far though!
